description: Public Transport - Timetables - For Realtime is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. Static timetables, stop locations, pathways for trains, and route shape information in GTFS format for operators that support realtime. Covers Buses, Ferries, Light Rail, Trains, Metro and Regional Bus Services (our regional services are at times referenced as "TCB" - Transport Connected Bus). Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Transport Connected Bus, Transportation, buses, ferries, gtfs. It offers 1 resource(s) in API. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
